headline: Approved prior meeting minutes; heard updates on summer program, BEST project, year-to-date financials, and youth diversion.
summary: Members approved the minutes of the June 10, 2026 meeting. Staff presented reports on supervisor updates, the summer program, the BEST project, financials, and the youth diversion team.
decisions: Approved the June 10, 2026 Regular Meeting Minutes, all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: Made by Commissioner Kilby to approve the June 10, 2026, Youth and Community Services Regular Meeting Minutes Seconded by Commissioner Garay; all in favor; motion carried.

plain_text:
Youth and Community Services Commission 
 Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 6:00 p.m.  
Bristol Parks, Recreation, Youth and Community Services – 51 High Street, Bristol, CT 06010 
 
 
1. Call to Order 
Chair Matthew Gotowala called the meeting to order at 6:01 p.m. 
 a. Pledge of Allegiance 
 
 
 
 b. Attendance 
 Members Present: Matthew Gotowala, Chair 
Cecilia Garay, Commissioner  
Richard Kilby, Commissioner 
Jonathan Lukasiewicz, Commissioner 
Donna Osuch, Commissioner 
Steven Seymour, City Council Liaison 
Stephen Bynum, Youth and Community 
Services Supervisor  
Dr. Joshua Medeiros, Superintendent of  
Bristol Parks, Recreation, Youth and 
Community Services 
Jeffrey Arduini, Community Services 
Coordinator 
Deedra Willingham, B.E.S.T Project 
Coordinator 
  
Absent: Deborah Ahl, Vice Chair  
Ryan Broderick, Commissioner  
Antonio Chatfield, Commissioner 
RJ Motel, Commissioner 
Steve Seymour, City Council Liaison  
  
 
2. Public Participation 
None.
3. Approval of Minutes 
 
 a. Approval of the June 10, 2026, Youth and Community Services Commission 
Regular Meeting Minutes 
 MOTION: Made by Commissioner Kilby to approve the June 10, 2026, Youth and 
Community Services Regular Meeting Minutes 
Seconded by Commissioner Garay; all in favor; motion carried.  
 
4. Supervisor's Report 
 
 a. Supervisor's Report 
 Youth and Community Services Supervisor Stephen Bynum presented the Supervisor's 
Report. Supervisor Bynum updated the commission on intakes, families, clients receiving 
services, and referrals. Community Services Coordinator Jeffrey Arduini currently serves 
108 clients and provided updates on the Parent and Child Program. Discussion followed.  
 
 b. Summer Program Update 
 Youth and Community Services Supervisor Stephen Bynum presented the Summer 
Program Update. Discussion followed.  
 
 c. BEST Update 
 BEST Project Coordinator Deedra Willingham presented the BEST updates. Discussion 
followed.  
 
 d. Year-to-Date Financials 
 Youth and Community Services Supervisor Stephen Bynum presented the Year-to-Date 
Financials. Discussion followed.  
 
 e. Youth Diversion Team 
 Youth and Community Services Supervisor Stephen Bynum presented updates from the 
Youth Diversion Team. Discussion followed.  
 
5. Youth Report 
Commissioner Parenti presented the Youth Report. Discussion followed.  
6. New Business
a. CADCA Training Presentation 
 Community Services Coordinator Jeffrey Arduini presented the CADCA Training 
Presentation. Discussion followed.  
 
 b. By Commissioners 
 None 
 
7. Old Business 
 
 a. By Commissioners 
 None. 
 
8. Adjournment 
MOTION: Made by Commissioner Parenti to adjourn at 6:45 p.m. 
Seconded by Commissioner Lukasiewicz; all in favor; motion carried.  
  
Respectfully Submitted,  
Amaris Estrada 
Recording Secretary 
Youth and Community Services Commission
